# ChunkReady

> **Kind:** tag · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/renderer/terrain/`](../folders/src-renderer-terrain.md)
> **Source:** [`src/renderer/terrain/terrain_sys.h`](../../../src/renderer/terrain/terrain_sys.h)

## Summary

The chunk's mesh was recorded into a compute batch submitted before this frame's graphics, so it is drawable.

## Description

Empty struct emplaced (emplace_or_replace) by TerrainSys::tick together with ChunkGPU, in the same tick the dispatch is recorded; the graphics submit of the same frame waits on the compute semaphore, so the mesh is drawable immediately. Never removed individually: it disappears with the chunk entity or when TerrainSys's destructor clears the storage. TerrainPass and GrassPass draw only entities with both ChunkGPU and ChunkReady; the debug menu counts ChunkReady entities as 'meshed'.

None (tag, opaque type or no data members).
